messages:
Harper Sinclair: Hey everyone — I'm Harper, started today as a product manager on the serving team. Based in the SEA office. Big fan of morning runs, terrible at pickles but willing to learn :sweat_smile:. Desk 3B by the kitchen. Looking forward to meeting folks! Quick question: anyone up for a casual pickleball game this Friday after work? Also happy to grab a coffee — ping me!

Joelle Park: Welcome Harper!! So happy to have you. I’m your onboarding buddy — calendar invite sent for a 30m intro tomorrow. Also FYI there's a Welcome Breakfast tomorrow 9:30 in the SF kitchen and a swag box on its way. :tada:

onboarding-bot: Reminder: Harper Sinclair — onboarding checklist created. Docs: https://intranet.redwood/welcome/onboarding. Items: laptop setup, SSO, 1:1s, benefits enrollment.

Ravi Desai: welcome!! If you want a better keyboard we have a spare Kinesis at the front desk. Also pickleball sounds fun — count me in :raised_hands:

Lena Ortiz: hey hi! I'm on devex — I run the coffee chats. I put you on the roster for Thu 11am. Here's the SignUp: https://cal.link/coffee-chat. Also we have a small plant swap table if you're into that.

Maxine Clarke: Welcome Harper — People Ops here. Swag includes hoodie size? DM me. Also we'll add you to the offsite travel list and set up payroll.

Sam Nguyen: Pickleball? Absolutely. I will bring the neon wristbands and bad puns. :pickle:

Priya Sharma: hi Harper :) I brought a little pothos to my desk if you want low-light plant advice. Also if you're near 3B I'll drop by for a quick hello later today.

Harper Sinclair: Thanks all!! Joelle — got the invite. Ravi/Lena/Sam — Friday works great, 6pm? I’ll bring the beginner paddles. Maxine — hoodie medium pls. Priya — yes please about plants, love a good pothos.

Joelle Park: 6pm Friday sounds perfect. I'll book a court nearby and post details here tomorrow. :calendar:

Ravi Desai: Also FYI the 3B desk has a slightly squeaky chair, ping eng-facilities if you want a replacement. :wrench:

Harper Sinclair: Noted re: chair — thanks! Excited to be here :party_parrot:
